8.19. iLock_Geography.lcf.parse¶

The module contains functions for parsing various LCF files.

Functions

parseLCF2Inst(path) Parses a file according to the LCF2Inst-cfg-1.1 or LCF2Inst-cfg-2.0 format.
parseLCF2Par(path[, namespaceSep]) Parses a file according to the LCF2Par-cfg-1.1 or LCF2PAR-cfg-2.0 format.
parseLCF2Tab(path) Parses a file according to the LCF2Tab-cfg-1.0, LCF2Tab-cfg-1.1, or LCF2Tab-cfg-2.0 format.
validateTableSignature(sig, table, path)

Classes

InstRule(source, userType, destTypeName, …) Represents an instantiation rule from a LCF2Inst file.
LCF2TabConfig(tableTypes, rules) The contents of a LCF2Tab file
LCFTableType(source, id, primary, signature, …)
ParRule(source, paramName, tableName, …[, …]) Represents a parameter rule from a LCF2Par file.
PipelineRule(source, tableName, pipeline) Represents a pipeline rule from a LCF2Tab file
TabRule(source, tableName, method, args) Represents a table calculation rule from a LCF2Tab file.
TableFilter(filterTable, isPositive) Specifies a rule for how to filter tables.
